author: espoirschooloflife
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations. ✨ How to Apply: If you want to help us bring these island narratives to life, please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: • Contact Information • Portfolio Link • Expected Rate/Project Quotation We can’t wait to see your work! 🌴✨

author: alipollesauthor
title: Looking for artist for book projects
content: 🎨 LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! 📚✨ I’m looking to connect with an artist/illustrator that I can work with for future book projects! I’d love to find someone who creates: ✨ Character art 📖 Book cover designs 🖤 Fantasy, romantasy, paranormal & contemporary romance artwork 🎨 Other book-related illustrations and promotional art I am specifically looking for an artist who creates their work WITHOUT the use of AI-generated artwork. I want to support human artists and build a relationship with someone I can hopefully work with on multiple projects in the future. I’m a published indie author with several books already out and plenty more planned, so I’d love to find someone who is open to ongoing paid commissions. 💕 If you’re an artist—or know someone you think would be a great fit—please tag them below or send me their portfolio/page! Feel free to share this post to help me find the right person! 🖤📚 — Ali Polles, Author

title: Open collaboration for book illustrators and designers
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Nah, buat kamu para illustrator dan designer, kami lagi ngebuka kesempatan kolaborasi untuk terlibat langsung dalam proses penerbitan buku cetak. Tidak ada deadline ya, silahkan mendaftar jika tertarik, akan kami cek berkala. Tertarik buat gabung? Langsung isi formulir di sini ya 👇 🔗 bit.ly/talentmalakabooks #MalakaBooks #TalentMalakaBooks
